[[Mumbai]].{{citation|url=https://www.axisbank.com/docs/default-source/annual-reports/for-axis-bank/annual-report-2019.pdf|title= Axis Bank Annual Report PDF 2018–19|work=Axix Bank}} It is India's third largest private sector bank by assets and fourth largest by market capitalisation. It sells financial services to large and mid-size companies, SMEs and retail businesses. As of 30 June 2016, 30.81% shares are owned by the promoters and the promoter group ([[United India Insurance Company|United India Insurance Company Limited]], [[Oriental Insurance Company Limited]], [[National Insurance Company Limited]], [[New India Assurance]], [[General Insurance Corporation of India]], [[Life Insurance Corporation of India]] and [[Unit Trust of India]]).{{cite web|title=Statement showing shareholding pattern of the Promoter and Promoter Group|url=http://www.bseindia.com/corporates/shpPromoterNGroup.aspx?scripcd=532215&qtrid=90.00&QtrName=June%202016|website=BSE|access-date=8 October 2016}} The remaining 69.19% shares are owned by mutual funds, [[Institutional investor#India|FIIs]], banks, insurance companies, corporate bodies and individual investors.{{cite web|title=Statement showing shareholding pattern of the Public shareholder|url=http://www.bseindia.com/corporates/shpPublicShareholder.aspx?scripcd=532215&qtrid=90.00&QtrName=June%202016|website=BSE|access-date=8 October 2016}} ==History== The bank was founded on 3 December 1993 as [[UTI Asset Management|UTI Bank]] as a part of [[UTI Asset Management|Unit Trust of India]], a [[Government of India]] entity, opening its registered office in [[Ahmedabad]] and a corporate office in Mumbai.{{cite web|last1=Kotak|first1=Uday|title=Uday Kotak: Now, wait for the next Big Thing|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/bs-40-now-wait-for-the-next-big-thing-114102701284_1.html|website=Business Standard India|access-date=1 October 2016|date=27 October 2014}} The bank was promoted jointly by the Administrator of the [[Unit Trust of India]] (UTI),{{cite web|title=SUUTI money belongs to UTI investors and not to the government by enforcing the l|url=http://www.firstpost.com/business/suuti-money-belongs-to-uti-investors-and-not-to-the-government-1353335.html|publisher=Firstpost|access-date=1 October 2016|date=22 January 2014}} [[Life Insurance Corporation of India]] (LIC), General Insurance Corporation, National Insurance Company, [[New India Assurance|The New India Assurance Company]], The Oriental Insurance Corporation and [[United India Insurance Company]]. The first branch was inaugurated on 2 April 1994 in [[Ahmedabad]] by [[Manmohan Singh]], then finance minister of India.{{Citation needed|date=January 2026}} In 2001 UTI Bank agreed to merge with [[Global Trust Bank (India)|Global Trust Bank]], but the [[Reserve Bank of India]] (RBI) withheld approval and the merger did not take place. In 2004, the RBI put Global Trust under moratorium and supervised its merger with [[Oriental Bank of Commerce]]. The following year, UTI bank was listed on the [[London Stock Exchange]].{{cite web|title=AXIS BANK REGS share price (AXB)|url=http://www.londonstockexchange.com/exchange/prices-and-markets/stocks/summary/company-summary/US05462W1099USUSDIOBE.html|website=London Stock Exchange|access-date=1 October 2016}} In 2006, UTI Bank opened its first overseas branch in [[Singapore]]. The same year it opened an office in [[Shanghai]], [[China]]. In 2007, it opened a branch in the [[Dubai International Financial Centre]] and branches in [[Hong Kong]].{{cite web|title=India's Axis Bank seeks Gulf expansion with branch in Sharjah|url=https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/india-s-axis-bank-seeks-gulf-expansion-with-branch-in-sharjah-1.187368/|website=The National|date=18 February 2016 |access-date=1 October 2016}} On 30 July 2007, UTI Bank changed its name to Axis Bank.{{Cite web |date=2007-07-30 |title=UTI Bank is now Axis Bank |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/kHWbcToVD2OSRnDNXVqGeP/UTI-Bank-is-now-Axis-Bank.html |access-date=2026-01-05 |website=mint |language=en}} In 2009, [[Shikha Sharma]] was appointed as the MD and CEO of Axis Bank.{{Cite news|last=P. Mampatta|first=Sachin|date=16 May 2013|title=Shikha Sharma gets a salary hike|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/shikha-sharma-gets-a-salary-hike-113051600522_1.html|access-date=11 September 2019}} In 2013, Axis Bank's subsidiary, Axis Bank UK commenced banking operations.{{cite web|last1=Rebello|first1=Joel|title=Axis Bank launches its first overseas subsidiary|url=http://www.livemint.com/Industry/L6pDpFwXLzVgRVnupAt17O/Axis-Bank-launches-its-first-overseas-subsidiary.html|access-date=1 October 2016|website=Mint newspaper|date=12 July 2013 }} In March 2014, the Indian government sold a 9% stake, out of its total 20.7% stake in Axis Bank.{{cite news |last1=Machado |first1=Kenan |last2=Jagota |first2=Mukesh |title=Indian Government to Sell Part of Axis Bank Stake |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/indian-government-to-sell-part-of-axis-bank-stake-1395332182 |access-date=1 March 2025 |work=Wall Street Journal |date=20 March 2014}} In 2017, Axis Bank acquired [[Freecharge]], a digital marketplace for financial services for approximately ₹385 crore.{{Cite news|last=Variyar|first=Mugdha|title=Axis Bank acquires FreeCharge for Rs 385 crore|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/startups/axis-bank-acquires-freecharge-for-rs-385-crore/articleshow/59789257.cms|access-date=13 October 2020}} On 1 January 2019, [[Amitabh Chaudhry]] took over as MD and CEO.{{Cite news|agency=Press Trust of India|date=31 December 2018|title=Shikha Sharma retires as Axis Bank MD & CEO, Amitabh Chaudhry to succeed|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/axis-bank-md-ceo-shikha-sharma-retires-118123100873_1.html|access-date=11 September 2019}} In 2021, Axis Bank had reduced its stake in [[Yes Bank]] from 2.39% to 1.96%.{{cite news |last1=Manohar |first1=Asit |title=Axis Bank trims stake in Yes Bank |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/axis-bank-trims-stake-in-yes-bank-11620105141355.html |access-date=5 May 2021 |publisher=mint |date=4 May 2021 |language=en}} In 2023, Axis Bank completed the acquisition of [[Citibank India]]'s consumer banking business for {{INRconvert|12325|c|mode=historical|year=2022}}.{{Cite news|work=business today|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/industry/banks/story/axis-bank-acquires-citis-india-consumer-business-for-rs-12325-cr-327964-2022-03-30 |title=Axis Bank acquires Citi's India consumer business for Rs 12,325 cr |date=30 March 2022 }} In 2025, Axis Bank has partnered with [[JPMorgan Chase|J.P. Morgan]] to provide real-time U.S. dollar payment capabilities for commercial clients in India.{{Cite web |last=Chaze |first=Aaron |date=2025-05-08 |title=GIFT City Takes Off With Axis Bank Lease Deal |url=https://gfmag.com/capital-raising-corporate-finance/gift-city-takes-off-with-axis-bank-lease-deal/ |access-date=2026-01-05 |website=Global Finance Magazine |language=en-US}}{{Cite news |last=Vora |first=Nimesh |date=28 March 2025 |editor-last=Cheema |editor-first=Sonia |title=India's Axis Bank, J.P. 2026 |work=[[Reuters]]}} ==Operations== ===Indian business=== [[File:Axis_Bank,_Temple_Road,_Mysore.jpg|thumb|Axis Bank branch in [[Mysore]]]] As of 31 December 2024, the bank had a network of 5,706 branches and extension counters, 14,476 automated teller machines and cash recyclers.{{Cite news |date=17 January 2025 |title=Axis Bank Q3 PAT rises 4% YoY to Rs 6,304 cr |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/axis-bank-q3-pat-rises-4-yoy-to-rs-6-304-cr-125011700246_1.html |access-date=26 January 2025 |work=[[Business Standard]]}} |url=http://www.cbrc.gov.cn/govView_F8C3E31D835F4E0DAAF60B25A49C7D89.html |title=中国银监会关于印度同心银行有限公司上海分行开业的批复 |publisher=中国银行业监督管理委员会 |date=28 August 2013 representative offices at Dhaka, Dubai, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi, which focus on corporate lending, trade finance, syndication, investment banking and liability businesses.{{cite web|title=Axis Bank enters Bangladesh, opens representative office in Dhaka|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/axis-bank-enters-bangladesh-opens-rep-office-in-dhaka-115112200293_1.html|website=Business Standard India|date=23 November 2015}} In |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190207105556/https://in.reuters.com/article/axis-bank-licence-britain-idINDEE96A0BK20130711 |url-status=dead |archive-date=7 February 2019 |title=Axis Bank to open for business in Britain |newspaper=Reuters |date=11 July 2013 |access-date=26 January 2014}} ==Services== ===Retail banking=== The bank offers lending services to individuals and small businesses, along with liability products, card services, Internet banking, [[automated teller machine]]s services, depository, financial advisory services, and [[Non-resident Indian and person of Indian origin|Non-resident Indian]] (NRI) services.{{cite web |url=http://www.axisbank.com/download/Annual-Report-2013.pdf |title=Annual Report for the year 2012–2013 |publisher=Axis Bank |access-date=26 January 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140122213622/http://www.axisbank.com/download/Annual-Report-2013.pdf |archive-date=22 January 2014 |url-status=dead }} Axis bank is a participant in RBI's NEFT enabled participating banks list.{{cite web|url = https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/bs_viewcontent.aspx?Id=112|title = RBI's list of Banks participating in NEFT|access-date = 31 August 2015|publisher = Reserve Bank of India}} ===Corporate banking=== Transaction banking: Axis Bank provides products and services related to transaction banking to customers in areas of current accounts, cash management services, capital market services, trade, foreign exchange and derivatives, cross-border trade and correspondent banking services, and tax collections on behalf of the Government and various State Governments in India.{{cite web|title=Transaction banking huge focus for Axis Axis Capital Limited provides investment banking services relating to equity capital markets, institutional stock brokering besides M&A advisory. October 2016|website=[[Sify]]|access-date=4 October 2016}} ==Listing and shareholding== Axis Banks's [[Common stock|equity shares]] are listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE) and [[National Stock Exchange of India]] (NSE).{{cite web|title=Listing Information – Axis Bank|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/axis-bank-ltd/infocompanylisting/companyid-9175.cms|access-date=26 January 2014|website=Economic Times}} The company's [[global depository receipt]]s (GDRs) are listed on the [[London Stock Exchange]].{{cite web|title=Axis Bank Limited GDR|url=http://www.londonstockexchange.com/exchange/prices-and-markets/stocks/summary/company-summary.html?fourWayKey=US05462W1099USUSDIOBE|access-date=26 January 2014|publisher=London Stock Exchange}} The Bonds issued by the bank under the [[Medium term note|MTN]] program are listed on the [[Singapore Exchange|Singapore Stock Exchange]]. ==Issues and concerns== ===Operation Red Spider=== {{Main|Operation Red Spider}} An Indian online magazine [[Operation Red Spider|conducted a sting operation]] which was publicised along with 2013 videos evidence showing a wide range of violations and money-laundering schemes by top officials at a number of Indian banks, including Axis Bank. Consequently, penalties of {{INRConvert|50|m}} on Axis Bank, {{INRConvert|45|m}} on [[HDFC Bank]], and {{INRConvert|10|m}} on [[ICICI Bank]] were imposed by the [[Reserve Bank of India]].{{cite web|title=RBI penalises Axis Bank, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank|url=https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=28840|publisher=Reserve Bank of India|access-date=25 December 2016}} ===2016 demonetisation-related money laundering=== Following the [[2016 Indian banknote demonetisation]], a number of Axis Bank employees were arrested for facilitating money laundering activities.{{cite news|title=Demonetisation: ED arrests 2 bank managers for laundering|url=http://www.ptinews.com/news/8152329_Demonetisation--ED-arrests-2-bank-managers-for-laundering|access-date=25 December 2016|publisher=Press Trust of India|date=5 December 2016}} Some media outlets highlighted the disproportionate number of cases involving the bank, and claimed that the bank's aggressive performance targets and internal culture fostered such activities and that the blame does not lie solely in the hands of arrested employees.{{cite news|last1=Hazari|first1=Hemindra|title=Axis Bank – A License to Launder?|url=https://thewire.in/89211/axis-bank-license-launder/|access-date=25 December 2016|publisher=The Wire|date=23 December 2016}} ==Subsidiaries== === Axis Capital Ltd. === Axis Capital Ltd. was incorporated in India as a wholly owned subsidiary of the bank on 6 December 2005 and received its certificate of commencement of business on 2 May 2006. Certain businesses of M/s. Enam Securities Pvt. Ltd. were merged with Axis Capital Ltd. as part of a scheme and the following companies became direct subsidiaries of Axis Capital:{{Cite web|title=Axis Capital (India) Company Profile: Acquisition & Investors {{!}} PitchBook|url=https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/43086-25|access-date=2020-12-07|website=pitchbook.com|language=en}} # Axis Securities Ltd. (formerly Enam Securities Direct Pvt. Ltd.) # Axis Finance Ltd. (formerly Enam Finance Pvt. Ltd.) # Axis Securities Europe Ltd. (formerly Enam Securities Europe Ltd.) # Enam International Ltd., UAE (voluntarily dissolved with effect from 24 August 2014) Axis Securities Ltd., Axis Finance Ltd. and Axis Securities Europe Ltd. later became direct subsidiaries of the bank in line with the RBI directives.{{Citation needed|date=December 2020}} In 2024, Axis Capital was barred from taking on any new debt assignments by SEBI, the Indian securities regulator, on account of irregularities it found in the non-convertible debentures (NCDs) issue of Sojo Infotel, a tech consultancy.{{cite news |last1=Kumar |first1=Shivendra |title=Sebi bars Axis Capital from debt merchant banking activities until further orders |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/sebi-bars-axis-capital-from-debt-merchant-banking-activities/articleshow/113496941.cms?from=mdr |newspaper=The Economic Times |date=19 September 2024 |access-date=2 November 2024}} === Axis Securities Ltd. === Axis Securities Ltd.was incorporated in India on 21 July 2006. The sales and securities business, including the retail broking business of Axis Capital Ltd, was merged with ASL on 25 May 2013. ASL is a wholly owned subsidiary of the bank and offers retail asset products, credit cards and retail brokerage services.{{Cite web|url=https://simplehai.axisdirect.in/|title=About Axis Securities|website=simplehai.axisdirect.in|language=en-gb|access-date=24 September 2019}} === Axis Private Equity Ltd. === Axis Private Equity Ltd. was incorporated in India as a wholly owned subsidiary of the bank on 3 October 2006 and received its certificate of commencement on 4 December 2006. APE manages investments, venture capital funds and offshore funds.{{citation needed|date=January 2020}} === Axis Mutual Fund === {{Main|Axis Mutual Fund}} Axis Mutual Fund is a subsidiary of Axis Bank established in 2009 with in headquarters in [[Mumbai]]. ==See also== {{Portal|Banks}} * [[Banking in India]] * [[List of banks in India]] * [[Reserve Bank of India]] * [[Indian Financial System Code]] == References == {{Reflist}} ==External links== * {{official website|Https://www.axis.bank.in|name=Official website}} * Business data for Axis Bank: [https://www.reuters.com/finance/stocks/overview/AXBK.NS Reuters] [https://www.google.com/finance/quote/AXISBANK:NSE Google Finance] [https://www.bloombergquint.com/stock/112501/axis-bank-ltd BloombergQuint] {{Banking in India}} {{Financial services in India|state=collapsed}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} {{BSE Sensex}} {{S&P CNX Nifty companies}} {{Authority control}} [[Category:Axis Bank| ]] [[Category:Banks based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1993]] [[Category:Banks established in 1993]] [[Category:Companies listed on the London Stock Exchange]] [[Category:NIFTY 50]] [[Category:BSE SENSEX]] [[Category:1993 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Asset management companies]] [[Category:Multinational companies headquartered in India]] [[Category:Formerly government-owned companies of India]]

Axis Bank Limited is an Indian multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's third largest private sector bank by assets and fourth largest by market capitalisation. It sells financial services to large and mid-size companies, SMEs and retail businesses.
As of 30 June 2016, 30.81% shares are owned by the promoters and the promoter group (United India Insurance Company Limited, Oriental Insurance Company Limited, National Insurance Company Limited, New India Assurance, General Insurance Corporation of India, Life Insurance Corporation of India and Unit Trust of India). The remaining 69.19% shares are owned by mutual funds, FIIs, banks, insurance companies, corporate bodies and individual investors.
